note: Holy Paladin boss lines follow the per-dungeon dispel, Blessing of Freedom and Blessing of Protection recommendations from Wowhead's Holy Paladin M+ tips. Cooldown placement (Aura Mastery, Avenging Wrath, Divine Toll, Blessing of Sacrifice) has no boss-specific guide, so the general principles of Wowhead's rotation guide were applied to each mechanic. Dispel types follow the in-game tooltips.

general.name: General
general.sub: Kit summary · pick your Hero talent above

i: tip
Using Divine Toll makes your next 2 Holy Power abilities apply Dawnlight. With Aurora, the first one gets Divine Purpose and is free
tip
Your main spender is Eternal Flame. Use Light of Dawn only when Eternal Flame would heavily overheal (Wowhead)
tip
Sun's Avatar heals allies passing through the beams between you and your Dawnlight targets. Stand in the middle of the party
tip
In the Herald build, Ringing of the Heavens fires a 200% effectiveness Divine Toll when you activate Aura Mastery
tip
Wowhead's recommended hero talent for M+ (M+ Virtue build ★)
tip
Using Holy Bulwark (shield) turns it into Sacred Weapon (bonus healing). Both generate 3 Holy Power, so use them on cooldown when you're at 2 Holy Power or less
tb
Casting Holy Bulwark on yourself also gives one nearby ally a copy via Solidarity. Wowhead considers putting it on the tank this way the highest healing option
tip
When an armament expires, Laying Down Arms grants Infusion of Light. That's why Holy Light gets more weight than Holy Shock (Wowhead)
disp
Authoritative Rebuke: a successful dispel cuts Cleanse's cooldown by 1 sec, or 2 sec while you hold an armament
tip
The Lightsmith build gets 10% increased healing taken during Aura Mastery from Protection of Tyr, and 40% reduced Lay on Hands cooldown from Tirion's Devotion
aoe
Aura Mastery · 3 min · Devotion Aura damage reduction 12% for 8 sec
aoe
Avenging Wrath · 2 min · 20% more healing, damage and crit; 50% longer with Sanctified Wrath. Call of the Righteous build: 30 sec shorter CD, 5 sec shorter duration
aoe
Divine Toll · 45 sec (Quickened Invocation) · Holy Shock on up to 5 allies
aoe
Beacon of Virtue · 15 sec · Virtue build, 9 sec beacon on the target and 4 injured allies
tb
Blessing of Sacrifice · 2 min · target takes 30% less damage for 12 sec; you take the prevented damage
tb
Blessing of Protection · 5 min · immune to physical damage and harmful effects for 10 sec; drops the target's threat
tb
Lay on Hands · 10 min · instantly heals for your max health
tip
Divine Protection · 1 min · 20% damage taken reduction for 8 sec
tip
Divine Shield · 5 min · 8 sec immunity. Unbreakable Spirit cuts Divine Protection, Divine Shield and Lay on Hands cooldowns by 30%
disp
Cleanse 8 sec: magic, plus poison and disease with Improved Cleanse (all four M+ builds)
disp
Blessing of Freedom: removes root and slow debuffs. Wowhead recommends it for Regurgitate, Toxic Atrophy, Bloodthorn Roots and Condensed Mass
tb
Blessing of Protection: removes bleeds (Grievous Thrash, Thornspike, Severing Axe, etc., Wowhead). On a tank it drops their threat
int
None of the four M+ builds have Rebuke. Interrupt casts with Hammer of Justice (stun) and Blinding Light (AoE disorient); bosses are immune to both
tip
Battle res is Intercession (3 Holy Power); movement is Divine Steed, 2 charges
tip
Devour week: remove the debuff with Cleanse and Blessing of Freedom. Using Cleanse right away gets it back off cooldown before the debuff ends, so you can free one more person (Wowhead)
int
Ascendant week: lock down orbs all at once with Blinding Light
pos
Pulsar week: help collect orbs around other party members, and position so they can collect yours
tip
+12 and up, Xal'atath's Guile: each death costs 15 sec

items: Use {Divine Toll} on allies right before big trash pulls and boss AoE phases, then apply {Dawnlight} with the next 2 {Eternal Flame}s
Tank busters to keep a {Holy Shock} charge and {Blessing of Sacrifice} ready for: {busters}

lightsmith.title: Lightsmith notes
items: Tank busters to use {Holy Bulwark} on the tank for, or on yourself to share via {Solidarity}: {busters}
Use {Holy Bulwark} and {Sacred Weapon} on cooldown at 2 Holy Power or less, and spend the {Infusion of Light} from an expiring armament right away

Rav'i: [해제] Cleanse the Regurgitate disease; if several people are hit, clear the slow with Blessing of Freedom first
[광역 피해] Line up Aura Mastery or Avenging Wrath with Ssscavenging; Virtue build, pop Beacon of Virtue and cast Flash of Light on the beacon targets
[탱버] Support the tank through the 3-hit Hydrastrike with Holy Shock; if their health is low, use Blessing of Sacrifice
The Writhing Coil: [해제] Free party members with Toxic Atrophy stacks with Blessing of Freedom, and Cleanse the Spiteful Venom poison
[광역 피해] Survive the 35 sec Synchronized Venom DoT and Death Rattle by filling Holy Power with Divine Toll and chaining spenders
Zul'jan: [광역 피해] Rotate Divine Toll, Aura Mastery and Avenging Wrath in turn for each Ritual of the Fang
[참고] Top up party members who cleared Ritual Venom with Boneslicer right away with Holy Shock or an Infusion of Light Flash of Light
[탱버] If the tank is low for the 2-hit Chop Down, use Blessing of Sacrifice

Lightblossom Trinity: [광역 피해] Line up Divine Toll with Lightbloom Overgrowth and Mythic Bedrock Surge; Virtue build, pop Beacon of Virtue too
[탱버] Bedrock Slam includes Nature damage, so Blessing of Protection can't block all of it. Support with Holy Shock and Blessing of Sacrifice
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [해제] Free allies rooted by Bloodthorn Roots with Blessing of Freedom (Wowhead). Per the tooltip it's magic, so Cleanse also works
[광역 피해] Divine Toll for Thorncaller Roar; after 50%, chain Aura Mastery and Avenging Wrath through Lightcrazed Frenzy without overlapping them
Lightwarden Ruia: [해제] Clear dangerous Grievous Thrash bleed stacks on DPS and healers with Blessing of Protection (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Save Aura Mastery and Avenging Wrath for Spirits of the Vale after 40%; if your health is low, use Divine Shield to take yourself off the healing list
Ziekket: [해제] Blessing of Protection can clear the Thornspike bleed, but it drops the tank's threat, so only use it when the tank asks
[광역 피해] For constant Oozing Xylem damage, use Divine Toll on cooldown to fill Holy Power; if mana is short, cast Holy Light less

The Hoardmonger: [해제] Cleanse the Toxic Spores poison. Lightsmith gets a shorter Cleanse cooldown from Authoritative Rebuke, so it can dispel more often
[광역 피해] Alternate Aura Mastery and Divine Toll for Ravenous Bellow
Sentinel of Winter: [해제] Cleanse the Glacial Torment magic DoT
[해제] When Rime Detonation goes off, clear the movement impairment with Blessing of Freedom (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Use Divine Toll for the party-wide Frozen Tempest DoT
Nalorakk: [광역 피해] Divine Toll after the Overwhelming Onslaught knockback, Aura Mastery for Fury of the War God
[참고] Use Blessing of Sacrifice on party members who are low from blocking Echo several times

Kystia Manaheart: [해제] Cleanse the Corroding Spittle magic DoT. It's an 8 sec cooldown, so dispel one at a time, most endangered first
[광역 피해] Use Divine Toll every Destabilized, and alternate Aura Mastery and Avenging Wrath
Zaen Bladesorrow: [광역 피해] When Killing Spree overlaps with the Fel-Infused Freight DoT, use Aura Mastery
Xathuux the Annihilator: [탱버] Healing barely lands during the 8 sec Legion Strike healing reduction, so share the tank's damage with Blessing of Sacrifice
[광역 피해] Divine Toll for Infernal Crush; Aura Mastery while an Axe Toss axe is still up
Lithiel Cinderfury: [광역 피해] Survive constant Searing Fel Flame damage by using Divine Toll and Beacon of Virtue (Virtue build) on cooldown
[차단] You have no interrupt, so stop Felfire Burst from Wild Imp packs with Blinding Light

Taz'Rah: [광역 피해] Line up Aura Mastery with Dark Bloom, and use Divine Toll right after Umbral Rupture
[참고] If Dark Bloom comes while you're low, pop Divine Shield and focus on healing the party
Atroxus: [탱버] Hulking Claw is nature damage, so Blessing of Protection can't block it. Use Blessing of Sacrifice
[광역 피해] Use Aura Mastery or Avenging Wrath while Toxic Creeper is alive
[해제] The Mind-Numbing Poison from Poison Splash and Poison Pool is a poison effect. Cleanse party members with the 30% haste reduction
Charonus: [해제] Clear the Condensed Mass slow on Gravitic Orbs targets with Blessing of Freedom (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Use Divine Toll or Aura Mastery for the 20 sec Cosmic Crash DoT

The Golden Serpent: [광역 피해] Use Divine Toll for Serpentine Gust and follow up with Holy Power spenders
[참고] Top up Spit Gold targets first with Holy Shock
Mchimba the Embalmer: [참고] Desiccation on Drain Fluids targets ends at 90% health or more, so fill them in one go with Holy Light or an Infusion of Light Flash of Light
The Council of Tribes: [해제] Clear Kula's Severing Axe bleed with Blessing of Protection. You can apply it before the cast finishes (Wowhead)
[해제] Cleanse the poison from Zanazal's Poison Nova
[탱버] Use Blessing of Sacrifice on the tank during the 10 sec of Shattered Defenses
Dazar, The First King: [광역 피해] Line up Aura Mastery and Avenging Wrath with Gilded Destruction, and fill low targets with an instant Hand of Divinity Holy Light
[탱버] Use Blessing of Sacrifice on the tank for the Blade Combo right after Savage Maul

Melidrussa Chillworn: [광역 피해] Aura Mastery for the intermission Frost Overload; fill with Divine Toll after the Chillstorm explosion
[참고] Holy Paladin has no interrupt and can't join the Frigid Shard interrupt rotation. Leave it to other party members
[해제] Infused Whelp's Cold Claws is a magic effect and becomes Frozen Solid at 20 stacks, so Cleanse the party members with the most stacks first
Kokia Blazehoof: [광역 피해] When Inferno stacks build up, use Aura Mastery or Divine Toll
[탱버] If Searing Wounds stacks are high after Searing Blows, use Blessing of Sacrifice on the tank
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [참고] Near the end of Interrupting Cloudburst, use instant spells like Holy Shock and Holy Power spenders instead of Holy Light or Flash of Light
[광역 피해] Stack Avenging Wrath and Aura Mastery in phase 2
[해제] The Stormslam debuff (381515) is a magic effect. It increases the tank's nature damage taken by 100% for 30 sec and stacks, so Cleanse it before the next Stormslam

Adderis & Aspix: [광역 피해] Use Avenging Wrath during the Aspix Frenzy phase after Adderis dies, and fill with Divine Toll before Thunder and Lightning
[참고] Heal Gust targets first with Holy Shock
Merektha: [해제] Cleanse the poison from the Toxic Viper's Poison Spit
[광역 피해] Use Aura Mastery for Serpentstorm
[탱버] If Lightning Bites come back to back, use Blessing of Sacrifice on the tank
Galvazzt: [참고] Move Beacon of Light to the beam soaker, or with the Virtue build, heal the soaker together using Beacon of Virtue
[광역 피해] Use Divine Toll for Induction AoE damage
Avatar of Sethraliss: [참고] For 30 sec after the Essence Defiler dies, pop Avenging Wrath and focus instant Hand of Divinity Holy Lights and Infusion of Light Flash of Lights on the Avatar
[제어] Lock down Faithless Tormentor packs chasing the healer with Blinding Light

85673.m: 신성한 힘 3개 / 15% (기본 마나 중) · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시

115750.m: 특성 · 1.2% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 1.5 분 재사용 대기시간

275773.m: 1.2% (기본 마나 중) · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 11 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능

의지의 힘으로 빛을 그러모아 신성한 무장으로 실체화한 뒤, 대상이 착용할 수 있도록 합니다.

433568.d:

1시간 동안 지속됩니다.

1242008.d: 응징의 격노 활성화 시 빛의 힘을 불러내 자신을 강화하여 다음 [응징의 성전사: 성스러운 빛 / 2회의 성스러운 빛]이 즉시 시전되고 마나 소모량은 50%만큼 감소합니다.
